summary: AI is accelerating, but most data foundations are still manual, fragmented, and reactive. Layering agents on brittle systems doesn't fix this — it inherits the same blind spots and trust gaps. In this session, discover how DQLabs' Prizm takes an AI-native approach to data observability, quality, and context — turning reactive data operations into a proactive, trusted foundation. Leave with a practical framework for assessing your own AI readiness and the steps to close the gap.
